Build Notes (Shared for all Variants)

Season 15 launch-week build on live patch 3.2.1 (live since 2026-09-15; Hotfix 1 changed no balance). Tier placements: d4builds A, InfinityBuilds A on its endgame list (Naotsonek), Maxroll endgame S (its only Rogue S), Maxroll push A and speedfarm A. A published build carried in the theorycraft slot because it ranks third among Rogue builds on the owner's weighted lists (d4builds > InfinityBuilds > Maxroll) and this site has not tested it. d4builds' description: 'Dance of Knives build with all imbuements but focused on Poison Imbuement that scales its damage with Imbuement Potency via the Spellbound Steel Talisman set and uniques like Etna's Lost Dagger and Cowl of the Nameless.' 3.2.1 facts: Spellbound Steel's Lucky Hit rises from 9% to 50% and Imbued Skills deal 60%[x] increased damage (and it now activates Inner Sight); Imbuement Potency now works for Shadow Clones with Etna's Lost Dagger; Dance of Knives press-and-hold is no longer out-cast by repeated casting. Disagreements kept visible: specialization (d4builds Inner Sight; Maxroll and InfinityBuilds Preparation); helm (d4builds Leoric's Crown with Hellfire + Pain and Cowl of the Nameless as a charm; Maxroll and InfinityBuilds Cowl as the helm with Hellfire in the amulet); and d4builds' Dash where the others run Smoke Grenade. Late endgame follows d4builds; the other stages follow Maxroll's planner. Hellfire costs this build little: the loadout's offensive affixes are Damage Over Time, Vulnerable and All Damage Multipliers with Imbuement Potency tempers and no Critical Strike affix (whether damage over time can crit is not in the knowledge base, unverified). Soul Splinters: d4builds runs five against the season article's 'up to three' among Jewelry slots; the true cap is unpublished — re-verify.

Rotation
  1. Keep Poison Imbuement and Dark Shroud up, Concealment or Dash every 8 seconds, Shadow Clone on cooldown, then hold Dance of Knives.
Variants

Leveling — Keep Poison Imbuement and Dark Shroud up, Shadow Clone on cooldown, hold Dance of Knives; Shadow Step and Dash to move.
Move on when At 70 with Asheara's Khanjar and Etna's Lost Dagger, respec to the Midgame bar with Smoke Grenade and Concealment.

Early Endgame — Keep Poison Imbuement and Dark Shroud up, Smoke Grenade and Concealment for Shrouded Gift, Shadow Clone on cooldown, hold Dance of Knives.
Move on when Move to the d4builds layout when Leoric's Crown, Fists of Fate and Squirt's Blouse are in hand and Cowl of the Nameless can move to the charm row.

Late Endgame — Maintain Poison Imbuement and Dark Shroud. Cast either Concealment or Dash every 8 seconds for Shrouded Gift and Danse Macabre. Cast Shadow Clone on CD. Cast and hold Dance of Knives. (d4builds rotation, 2026-09-16.)
Move on when Push when Leoric's Crown, Asheara's Khanjar, Etna's Lost Dagger and Shrouded Gift are Mythic; d4builds' defensive swap: Squirt's Blouse → Aspect of Disobedience.

Pushing — As late_endgame with Smoke Grenade in Dash's slot: Poison Imbuement and Dark Shroud up, Smoke Grenade or Concealment every 8 seconds, Shadow Clone on cooldown, hold Dance of Knives.

How to run them

d4builds (2026-09-16): hire Subo, reinforce with Varyana casting Bloodthirst on Skill Cast. Maxroll Midgame/Endgame hire Raheir with Aldkin (Field of Languish on Dance of Knives); Maxroll Pushing hires Subo with Raheir (Bastion when injured); InfinityBuilds hires Raheir with Aldkin (Field of Languish, trigger Injured). Hired-mercenary skill picks did not decode reliably, so none are listed.

Build Notes (Shared for all Variants)

Season 15 launch-week build on live patch 3.2.1 (live since 2026-09-15; Hotfix 1 changed no balance). Tier placements: d4builds A, InfinityBuilds A on its endgame list (Naotsonek), Maxroll endgame S (its only Rogue S), Maxroll push A and speedfarm A. A published build carried in the theorycraft slot because it ranks third among Rogue builds on the owner's weighted lists (d4builds > InfinityBuilds > Maxroll) and this site has not tested it. d4builds' description: 'Dance of Knives build with all imbuements but focused on Poison Imbuement that scales its damage with Imbuement Potency via the Spellbound Steel Talisman set and uniques like Etna's Lost Dagger and Cowl of the Nameless.' 3.2.1 facts: Spellbound Steel's Lucky Hit rises from 9% to 50% and Imbued Skills deal 60%[x] increased damage (and it now activates Inner Sight); Imbuement Potency now works for Shadow Clones with Etna's Lost Dagger; Dance of Knives press-and-hold is no longer out-cast by repeated casting. Disagreements kept visible: specialization (d4builds Inner Sight; Maxroll and InfinityBuilds Preparation); helm (d4builds Leoric's Crown with Hellfire + Pain and Cowl of the Nameless as a charm; Maxroll and InfinityBuilds Cowl as the helm with Hellfire in the amulet); and d4builds' Dash where the others run Smoke Grenade. Late endgame follows d4builds; the other stages follow Maxroll's planner. Hellfire costs this build little: the loadout's offensive affixes are Damage Over Time, Vulnerable and All Damage Multipliers with Imbuement Potency tempers and no Critical Strike affix (whether damage over time can crit is not in the knowledge base, unverified). Soul Splinters: d4builds runs five against the season article's 'up to three' among Jewelry slots; the true cap is unpublished — re-verify.

Rotation
  1. Keep Poison Imbuement and Dark Shroud up, Concealment or Dash every 8 seconds, Shadow Clone on cooldown, then hold Dance of Knives.
Variants

Leveling — Keep Poison Imbuement and Dark Shroud up, Shadow Clone on cooldown, hold Dance of Knives; Shadow Step and Dash to move.
Move on when At 70 with Asheara's Khanjar and Etna's Lost Dagger, respec to the Midgame bar with Smoke Grenade and Concealment.

Early Endgame — Keep Poison Imbuement and Dark Shroud up, Smoke Grenade and Concealment for Shrouded Gift, Shadow Clone on cooldown, hold Dance of Knives.
Move on when Move to the d4builds layout when Leoric's Crown, Fists of Fate and Squirt's Blouse are in hand and Cowl of the Nameless can move to the charm row.

Late Endgame — Maintain Poison Imbuement and Dark Shroud. Cast either Concealment or Dash every 8 seconds for Shrouded Gift and Danse Macabre. Cast Shadow Clone on CD. Cast and hold Dance of Knives. (d4builds rotation, 2026-09-16.)
Move on when Push when Leoric's Crown, Asheara's Khanjar, Etna's Lost Dagger and Shrouded Gift are Mythic; d4builds' defensive swap: Squirt's Blouse → Aspect of Disobedience.

Pushing — As late_endgame with Smoke Grenade in Dash's slot: Poison Imbuement and Dark Shroud up, Smoke Grenade or Concealment every 8 seconds, Shadow Clone on cooldown, hold Dance of Knives.

Reasoning

HypothesisDance of Knives should be a top-three Rogue endgame build on 3.2.1 because Spellbound Steel's rework (Lucky Hit 9% → 50%, Imbued Skills deal 60%[x] increased damage) and the Imbuement Potency fixes (now working for Shadow Clones with Etna's Lost Dagger; Dance of Knives press-and-hold no longer out-cast by repeated casting) make a Poison-imbued channel scale with Imbuement Potency through Etna's Lost Dagger, Asheara's Khanjar and Cowl of the Nameless. Three references publish it — d4builds A, InfinityBuilds A (Naotsonek), Maxroll endgame S (its only Rogue S) and push A — so this is a published build, carried in the theorycraft slot because it ranks third on the weighted lists and this site has not tested it.
Confidencehigh
How to test it(1) Specialization is disputed: d4builds runs Inner Sight (3.2.1: Spellbound Steel now activates Inner Sight), Maxroll and InfinityBuilds run Preparation — test both on a dummy with the same gear. (2) Helm: d4builds wears Leoric's Crown with Hellfire + Pain and puts Cowl of the Nameless in a charm slot; Maxroll and InfinityBuilds wear Cowl as the helm and put Hellfire in the amulet — compare. (3) d4builds' bar has Dash where the other two have Smoke Grenade; d4builds' rotation needs Concealment or Dash every 8 seconds for Shrouded Gift and Danse Macabre. (4) Confirm Hellfire costs nothing: the loadout rolls no crit. (5) Maxroll's Pushing profile lists Fer of the Sightless twice — whether a duplicate charm counts twice toward the set is unverified. (6) Compare against the Poison Penetrating Shot meta at equal Pit tier.

UpgradeForceful Arrow

Forceful Arrow pierces through the first enemy hit, deals 82.5% damage, and has a 30% chance to Execute enemies.

Twisted Twin

UpgradeTwisting Blades

Impaling an enemy with Twisting Blades also summons 1 Shade to strike a nearby target, dealing 31.5% damage on impale and 73.4% damage on returning.

Transporter

UpgradeFlurry

Flurry is also a Mobility Skill.

Casting Flurry deals 75%[x] increased damage, dashes you to the target, and grants 10%[x] increased Movement Speed for 4 seconds.

Trick Shot

UpgradePenetrating Shot

Whenever Penetrating Shot damages an enemy, 2 additional arrows split off to either side. These side arrows deal 50%[x] of Penetrating Shot's Base damage and do not split.

Artifice

UpgradeShadow Step

Shadow Step no longer requires a target, and it leaves a decoy at your starting location that Taunts Nearby enemies and explodes after 2 seconds, dealing 72% Shadow damage.

Shadow Step's Cooldown is increased to 12 seconds.

Pernicious Poisons

UpgradeCaltrops

Throw 3 smaller Caltrops that now deal Poison damage and 105% Poisoning damage over 6 seconds. Enemies affected by this Poisoning are Weakened

Echo

UpgradeDash

A Shade Dashes after you, dealing 131.3% damage. Dash's Cooldown is reduced by 1 second per enemy you hit, up to 5 seconds.

Calculation

UpgradeConcealment

Casting Concealment grants 4 stacks of Overpower. After breaking Concealment, you gain +10.0% increased Critical Strike Chance for the next 6 seconds.

Shade Grenade

UpgradeSmoke Grenade

Smoke Grenade no longer Dazes and deals 90% Shadow damage. When your Smoke Grenade detonates, it also creates a Shade that leaves behind 1 grenade, dealing 67.5% damage.

Smoke Grenade is now also a Core Skill that no longer has a Cooldown and costs 40 Energy.

Contamination

UpgradePoison Trap

Poison Trap bursts for an additional 162% damage when it triggers. Enemies hit by this burst take 40%[x] increased damage from Poison Trap.

Shadow Play

UpgradeShadow Imbuement

Lucky Hit: Shadow Imbued Skills have up to a 50% chance to create a Shade that explodes after 1 second, dealing 120% damage. This can only happen once every {x} seconds, affected by Attack Speed.

Corrosive Ring

UpgradePoison Imbuement

Passive: Poison Imbuement corrodes enemies around you, dealing 25% Poisoning damage over 6 seconds.

While imbued, the size of the corrosion is increased by 100%[+]. Each enemy affected by Poison Imbuement increases your Energy Regeneration by 10%[x], up to 100%[x].

Crystal Distillation

UpgradeCold Imbuement

When Cold Imbuement is Cast it now also creates a frigid emanation around you for 6 seconds that deals 75% Cold damage and Chills any enemies within for 15% every 0.5 seconds.

Monsoon

UpgradeRain of Arrows

Rain of Arrows no longer Immobilizes, and instead, its first wave Knocks Down enemies for 3 seconds.

Casting Rain of Arrows consumes 4 stacks of Overpower to send out 2 additional waves, each dealing 180% damage.

Explosive Trigger

UpgradeDeath Trap

Death Trap is also a Grenade Skill.

Death Trap also releases 16 Stun Grenades that each explode for 20% damage.

Sudden Death

UpgradeDeath Trap

Death Trap's arm time is reduced by 50%, and it deals a total of 280% damage in the area.

Casting Death Trap consumes 4 stack of Overpower to reduce arm time by 100% and increase its damage by 50%[x].

Relentless

UpgradeShadow Clone

Minimum Ferocity is increased by 4 as long as Shadow Clone is present. Shadow Clone's duration is increased by 5 seconds and deals 25%[x] increased damage.
